content.title: Fannie, Freddie privatization back in focus but major changes likely gradual: BofA
content.summary: Investing.com-- Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac privatization is back in focus as U.S. regulators signal possible steps to end conservatorships. But Bank of America expects any major change to be gradual, with government backing remaining firmly in place for now.

content.title: Bill Ackman’s Main Fund Is Up 25% in 2025. These 2 Investments Are Helping.
content.summary: Bill Ackman is having an impressive year: His main investment vehicle has returned 25% and been helped by its sizable holdings in  Freddie Mac  and Fannie Mae, whose shares have more than quadrupled in 2025.  The fund’s U.S.-listed shares closed 1% higher on Friday at $63.41 apiece after hitting a record high of $63.70 earlier in the session.  The shares have returned 32% so far this year, topping the NAV performance as the discount to NAV has narrowed.
